svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.74k stars in total, about 1.11k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 522, aube 2034, fnox 2283, hk 1271, pitchfork 688, usage 1058, +6 more 884.
